candidate: Selected 100-percent train-only candidate, using validation-only selection
metric: Mean absolute prediction error normalized by the target gain/front/tail tolerance scales (validation selection_score)
expansion_rule: Expand a route if relative normalized-error improvement from the 50-percent to the 100-percent grouped subset is at least 10 percent AND (the final normalized score exceeds 0.25 OR validation boundary timing P95 exceeds half a tolerance width). Also expand if a feasible independent validation request is missed at top-5 AND normalized-error improvement is at least 5 percent. Undefined feasible retention is not treated as perfect retention.
expansion_size: Increase only triggered route prefixes to min(30000, ceil(1.5 * current_attempt_prefix)) inside the already frozen input design, preserving the initial archive and all initial model evidence. Recheck coverage, all split identities and duplicate-label consistency before fitting.
stop_rule: After any justified expansion, review validation again; use the full frozen capacity when another material improvement remains plausible. Stop at the frozen capacity or diminishing returns, report persistent errors, and do not retune using final test metrics.
limitations: These are engineering study gates, not calibrated confidence intervals or guarantees of laboratory accuracy. The 0.25 and half-width gates tie data effort to conformity tolerances; measured optimization retention remains separately required. Only four approved model formulations/families are eligible.
boundary_metric_clarification: Use actual absolute prediction-minus-truth error on validation cases whose true timing is within 0.25 tolerance half-width of either conformity boundary. Existing training boundary_errors fields describe predicted distance outside the band, not near-boundary prediction error, and are excluded from this decision. This correction changes no fitted model or primary selection metric.
